description: Search eMarket Storage's DOCUMENT ARCHIVE — a SEPARATE repository from emarket_search_disclosures' press-release stream, covering the actual regulated filings: annual/half-year financial reports, ESEF/XBRL packages, AGM documentation and similar. Use this (not emarket_search_disclosures) when you need the annual report or ESEF package itself, not an issuer's press release ABOUT it — verified live 2026-10-19: Interpump's category=100 on emarket_search_disclosures returns only its results press release, while this tool's category=100 on the same issuer returns "IP - Annual Financial Report 2025" plus its ESEF XBRL ZIP. Same issuer ids, category codes, and INCLUSIVE date_to convention as emarket_search_disclosures — see that tool's description for the date-window mechanics. has_xbrl flags rows that carry a downloadable ESEF/XBRL ZIP (document_url then points at the .zip, not a .pdf). Category codes: 100=1.1 Relazioni finanziarie annuali e relazioni di revisione annuali; 101=1.2 Relazioni finanziarie semestrali e revisioni limitate; 102=1.3 Pagamento ai governi; 103=2.1 Stato membro d'origine; 104=2.2 Informazioni privilegiate; 105=2.3 Notifiche di partecipazioni rilevanti; 106=2.4 Acquisizione o cessione di azioni proprie dell'emittente; 107=2.5 Totale dei diritti di voto e del capitale; 108=2.6 Modifiche dei diritti inerenti alle categorie di azioni o valori mobiliari; 109=3.1 Ulteriori informazioni previste dalla regolamentazione nazionale; 110=MANTRA — Internal Dealing (operazioni di persone rilevanti e strettamente associate); 111=MANRSS — Relazione sulla gestione inclusa la dichiarazione di sostenibilità; 150=REGEM — Altre informazioni regolamentate (art. 65-ter Regolamento Consob 11971/1999).

azienda_id.description: Teleborsa's internal issuer id, from a prior emarket_search_disclosures or emarket_search_documents result.

category.description: Category code to filter by, e.g. "100" for annual financial reports/ESEF packages. See tool description for the full code list.

company.description: Free-text issuer name, e.g. "Interpump", "Saipem". Resolved against the same issuer picklist as emarket_search_disclosures. Optional — omit along with azienda_id to get every issuer's documents in the date window in one call.

date_from.description: Only documents published on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive). If date_to is omitted, searches just this one day.

date_to.description: Only documents published on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD, INCLUSIVE). Same exclusive-upstream-bound handling as emarket_search_disclosures.

limit.description: Number of documents to return (1-24). Default 10.

name: emarket_search_documents
title: Emarket Search Documents
